rules.rationale: High heteroatom load with a ring-rich scaffold maximizes polar and hydrogen-bonding surface, sharply lowering logD.
Aromatic hydrocarbon surface with few polar atoms favors transfer into octanol, the textbook high-logP signature.
A moderate heteroatom count imposes a sub-linear polarity cost relative to the hetero-high regime, consistent with additive fragment logP.
Halogen-free, heteroatom-free backbones are purely hydrocarbon and should partition strongly into the lipophilic phase.

skills.hypothesis: Lipophilicity is set mainly by heteroatom-driven polar surface, with aromatic hydrocarbon bulk rewarding partitioning. It may fail for zwitterions or intramolecularly hydrogen-bonded molecules whose apparent polarity diverges from measured logD.

rules.rationale: Short SMILES mark small compact molecules with limited polar inventory; shared-value prior shows a positive short-length effect on partitioning.
Long strings usually encode appended polar or flexible functionality whose hydration cost lowers the partition coefficient.
Rigid ring-rich skeletons with few branches expose little polar surface and pay small conformational entropy on transfer.
Moderate halogenation adds polarizable non-polar volume without hydrogen-bonding capacity, raising logP.

skills.hypothesis: Flexibility and size, not polar-atom count, dominate the lipophilicity signal; compact rigid scaffolds transfer as lipophilic while long flexible appendages penalize. It may fail for large purely alkyl chains that are genuinely lipophilic.

lesson: The compactness and rigidity skill improved mean development AUC (86.9) over the heteroatom-centered skill (84.5) across the same seeds, so length, branching, and ring rigidity appear to carry stronger lipophilicity signal here than heteroatom load alone; seed spread remains wide, so only directional conclusions are warranted.
revision_summary: Retained the mechanistic heteroatom/aromatic polarity skill as the polarity-grounded control but deployed the rigidity and compactness skill, since it matched the compactness and ring-rigidity signal that the source transfer effects favored and outscored the polarity skill on every-seed development AUC. Both skills keep 2-4 rules, exact catalog field/value pairs, and weights within range; the deployed skill downweights the uncertain heteroatom relation in favor of length, branch, ring, and halogen volume terms.
